preset.heading: Share with the community
preset.hint: Publish this team as a community preset others can adopt. Member agents are shared without any credentials.
preset.published: Team published to the community catalog
preset.failed: Couldn't publish this team as a preset

assignments.title: Assignments
assignments.empty_hint: Create a goal and decompose it into steps. The orchestrator runs them through your team in parallel.
assignments.step_description_placeholder: What does this step need to do?
assignments.error_step_incomplete: Every step needs a title and an assigned persona.
assignments.error_step_persona_required: Manual matching requires a persona for every step.
assignments.strategy_manual_hint: You pick the persona for each step at creation time.
assignments.strategy_embedding_hint: Each step's persona is resolved at run time via local fastembed cosine. Cheap; needs the ml build.
assignments.strategy_llm_eval_hint: Sonnet picks the best persona per step. One call per step; uses your Anthropic subscription.
assignments.auto_decompose_hint: Let Sonnet propose 2-6 steps for this goal. You can edit before submitting.
assignments.decompose_empty: Sonnet returned no steps — try a more specific goal.
assignments.review_hint: Adjust the requirement or pick a different team member, then re-run this step.
assignments.notification_failed_summary: Step "{step}" failed. Click to review and adjust.
assignments.notification_unmatched_summary: Step "{step}" has no eligible persona. Click to review.
assignments.save_template_hint: Save this title, goal, strategy and steps as a reusable template for this team.

agent_teams_subtitle: Manage teams, their personas, and orchestration
preset_team_picker_subtitle: Pre-wired, best-practice teams you can adopt and customize
preset_blueprint_hint: Tap a node to include or exclude it
no_teams_hint: Create a team to start assembling its roster

team_studio.learning_empty: No learning record — this mission finished before the team started learning from outcomes.
team_studio.learning_retro_skipped_busy: Retrospective skipped — another deliberation was active
team_studio.learning_no_lessons: No lessons yet — retrospectives will write them here.
team_studio.add_persona_none: Every persona is already on this team.
team_studio.add_persona_draft_hint: Draft personas must be promoted before they can join a team.
team_studio.board_empty: No assignments yet. Define a goal in Orchestrate to start one.
team_studio.orchestrate_subtitle: Describe the goal — the orchestrator routes it to the right personas.
team_studio.orchestrate_placeholder: e.g. Pull this week's customer feedback, triage the top themes, and draft a backlog summary.
team_studio.examples_helper: Not sure where to start? Tap an example to fill it in.
team_studio.example_goal_1: Review the latest PR, run the tests, and summarize what changed.
team_studio.example_goal_2: Research three competitors and draft a one-page comparison.
team_studio.example_goal_3: Triage new support tickets, group them by theme, and propose replies.
team_studio.example_goal_4: Draft a launch blog post, edit it, and prepare social snippets.
team_studio.assignment_dispatched: Assignment dispatched — the orchestrator is routing steps to members now.
team_studio.no_routing: No routing produced — try a more specific goal.
team_studio.no_capabilities_persona: This persona has no capabilities defined.
team_studio.select_member: Select a member to adjust its capabilities.
team_studio.empty_roster: This team has no personas yet. Add members to build its roster.
team_studio.workspace_hint: Shared instructions and defaults applied to every member of this team.
team_studio.shared_instructions_placeholder: Guidance appended to every team member's prompt — e.g. cite codebase evidence, prefer empirical over speculative judgments.
team_studio.disband_hint: Removes this team but keeps its personas — they just leave the roster.
team_studio.workspace_unsaved_body: You edited the workspace settings but haven't saved. Leave and discard the changes?
team_studio.deck_empty: No assignments yet — orchestrate one to put the team to work.
team_studio.deck_goal_chip_tooltip: Advances a goal — open the Goals hub
team_studio.identity_hint: Renaming or recoloring applies everywhere this team appears. Emptied fields are left unchanged.
team_studio.replay_no_output: No output recorded for this step.
team_studio.readiness_chip_tooltip: This teammate's connectors still need setup. It can join and discuss, but its capabilities are withheld — it won't take action until you add the credential (open the Connections section in the sidebar).
team_studio.slack_bridge_hint: Mirror this team channel to a Slack channel. Messages posted in Slack reach the team the way a directive does.
team_studio.slack_bridge_no_credential_body: Add a Slack bot token in Vault first. Once the connection is saved and verified, it appears here as a bridge target.
team_studio.slack_bridge_no_members: Add a persona to this team before bridging. The bridge is carried by one team member.
team_studio.slack_bridge_persona_hint: The bridge lives on this member notification channels. Any team member works.
team_studio.slack_bridge_persona_disabled_warning: This persona is disabled, so the bridge will not run. Enable it to start relaying.
team_studio.slack_bridge_channel_load_failed: Could not list channels. Enter the channel ID instead.
team_studio.slack_bridge_channel_manual_hint: No channels returned. Invite the bot to a channel, or enter its ID.
team_studio.slack_bridge_inbound_hint: Polls the Slack channel and delivers new messages to the team.
team_studio.slack_bridge_outbound_messages_hint: Mirrors what people and personas say in the team channel.
team_studio.slack_bridge_outbound_directives_hint: Mirrors the instructions handed to team members.
team_studio.slack_bridge_outbound_steps_hint: Every execution step. This is the chatty one, so leave it off unless you want a full trace in Slack.
team_studio.slack_bridge_save_disabled_reason: Pick a connection, a team member, and a channel first.
team_studio.slack_bridge_save_failed: Could not save the Slack bridge
team_studio.slack_bridge_unlink_body: The team stops mirroring to Slack and stops receiving Slack messages. Other notification channels on this persona are left alone.
team_studio.slack_bridge_legacy_warning: This persona uses an older notification format that cannot host a bridge. Pick another team member, or reconfigure its notification channels first.

memory_created: Memory saved to the team ledger
drag_agents_hint: Drag agents from the sidebar onto the canvas
team_codebase_hint: Wire this team to a GitHub repo so its agents share one source of truth.
run_pipeline_twice: Run the pipeline at least twice
no_matching_agents: No matching agents found. Create some agents first, then try again.
auto_team_subtitle: Describe an outcome, get a team
auto_team_placeholder: What do you want the team to do?
cycle_tooltip: Part of a cycle — execution order is heuristically determined. Consider removing circular connections or marking them as feedback edges.
cycle_warning: Execution order is arbitrary for: {nodes}. Consider removing circular connections or marking them as feedback edges.
run_pipeline_or_add: Run a pipeline or add one manually
relay_empty: No relays yet — the channel fills as the team works.
diff_legend: Green entries are new in the newer run; red entries are gone since the older run.
